digital.title: This website
digital.body: The digital product aims for WCAG 2.2 AA: semantic headings, keyboard, visible focus, 48px targets, bilingual lang, reduced motion, and text that does not rely on colour alone.

physical.title: The physical gathering
physical.body: UNESCO and UN India, with IIT Kharagpur, published accessibility SOPs for Kolkata Pujas in 2025 (ramps, Braille, resting areas, trained volunteers). That work is a reference. It is not evidence that a BKS venue has those features. No ramp, toilet, or route is claimed here.
